messages:
kevin: Hey — first week question. I'm putting together a short streaming demo for next Tue. Should I be using a hosted API key or is sandbox OK? I tried locally and started getting 429s when I opened multiple streams.

elaine (onboarding): For internal demos we often use sandbox, but for any customer-facing demo we recommend hosted (more predictable quota & lower chance of 429). If you need a short boost, ping eng-infra. :wave:

infra-bot: quota snapshot for kevin@example.com -> sandbox: 50 req/min, 5k tokens/day; hosted free tier: 20 req/min. If you need hosted dev token, contact @samir. (auto)

samir (eng-infra): @kevin — can you paste the exact 429 body? Commonly it's either "rate_limit" from concurrent streams or "quota_exceeded" from daily token cap. Also try this quick curl to repro (replace $KEY):

  curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" -sS https://api.redwood.ai/v1/streams -d '{"input":"hello"}'

kevin: Error body: {"error":"rate_limit","retry_after":1.2}. Happens when I spawn ~6 concurrent streams from my dev machine.

ops (platform): For short demos we usually hand out a hosted demo token with higher concurrency and a 24h TTL. @samir if this is fine I can issue one now. Also note if you're streaming from home, NAT/ISP can make bursts look higher — we recommend exponential backoff with jitter.

samir (eng-infra): Approved. @ops go ahead and create a hosted-demo token for kevin.

ops (platform): Done — @kevin check DM for a hosted-demo token with TTL 24h and 200 req/min concurrency. Try again and report if you still see 429s.

olivia (devex): Quick tip: the Console has "Create ephemeral key" under API Keys (30m TTL) which is super handy for live demos and avoids committing long-lived keys. Also handy to pair with the hosted-demo token if you want short sessions for attendees.

kevin: Awesome — received the token and retested, no 429s now. Thanks! One more Q: if we want a multi-day sandbox boost for a pilot, where do I request that?

elaine (onboarding): Use the "Sandbox quota increase" form linked in onboarding docs and cc your manager + eng-infra. For multi-day boosts we route through product/security for approval; expect ~1–2 business days.

kevin: Perfect, will do. Appreciate the quick help everyone! :pray:
